run_visualization_demo_on_image: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize instance segmentation on a single BGR image
run_visualization_demo_on_video: run a VisualizationDemo to predict and visualize segmentation on each frame of a video file
create_async_predictor: create an AsyncPredictor with multiple GPU workers to process images asynchronously via multiprocessing
use_async_predictor_put_get: use AsyncPredictor put and get methods to enqueue images and retrieve predictions in order
shutdown_async_predictor: shutdown an AsyncPredictor to cleanly stop all worker processes and clear task queues
